A8 seventeen twins closed. A2 the he/she item now names the asker (Patrik, already in this pack), so the accepts no longer look like an unspecified subject. cards.title: Reported speech
points: We tell someone what another person said.
We do not quote their exact words.

cards.title: When we use it
points: We pass on a message, or retell what someone said.

cards.title: The pattern
points: The verb often moves one step back. That move is **backshift**.

rows: She said she **had** lost her phone.

cards.title: say vs tell
points: **say** does not take a person object.

cards.title: Questions in reported speech
points: Inside: statement order — no inversion, no **do** / **does** / **did**.

cards.title: What does not always shift
points: If it is still true now, speakers sometimes keep present.
After past **said** / **told**, these sentences still backshift.

cards.title: Common mistakes
points: Czech often keeps one past or present look.
English steps the verb back after past **said** / **told**.
